main.description: Export patient timeline as FHIR R5 Bundle (type: collection). Caller MUST hold read-cap for each requested record; key-wrap discovery is server-assisted but decryption happens client-side. Output is application/fhir+json.

recipientDid.description: Caller DID, used to locate matching key-wrap records

includeKinds.description: Inner-type allowlist. Default: all karute inner types.

keyWrapRecord.description: AT URI of matching com.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap record for recipientDid

fhirBundleTemplate.description: Pre-populated FHIR Bundle skeleton (type, timestamp, identifier). Client fills entry[] after decrypt.
